Pure-run equivalence, replay, one committed terminal outcome, cancellation without partial results and observer/resource cleanup pass the 3622-test JVM/JS gate. Max step/gap/cancellation, runtime/workload identity and measured/final source digests are in docs/EXECUTION_RESPONSIVENESS.md and docs/evidence/detection-assembly-final.md. X2 remains conditional on its larger-grid consumer trigger; the retained 1024-square Gaussian stress case misses. No universal real-time or hosted supported-JDK guarantee. Current tranche is local and uncommitted.
